meta.title: Start your free Search Guard Trial now
meta.description: How to download and run your free 60 day Search Guard Enterprise Trial
title.headline: Start your free trial
title.text: You can use the completely Open Source and forever-free Community Edition, or start your 60 day Search Guard Enterprise trial
step1.headline: Download Search Guard
step1.text: Download the Search Guard plugin matching the Elasticsearch version you are running. For example, if you are running Elasticsearch 9.4.3, you need to download Search Guard for 9.4.3 as well. The download is platform-independant.
step2.headline: Install Search Guard
step2.text: Stop your Elasticsearch cluster and install Search Guard on all nodes.

step4.text: After installing Search Guard, start your cluster as normal:
